decision.why: Establish sample scope and data integrity before interpreting baseline failures or assigning a limited experiment budget.
decision.hypothesis: The manifest and image inventory will reveal whether all 32 development excerpts support melody, chord, timing and transposition assessment, and clarify the seven-song pilot scope.
decision.expected_observation: Dataset inventory, available input artifacts, integrity issues and evaluation scope sufficient to guide baseline inspection.

observation.label_policy: Recognition sees images only. References are opened by evaluation.
observation.release_limits: Conservative completion guard for this prototype, not a musician-agreed product release threshold. A seven-sample pilot cannot complete this goal. Report measured improvements separately.
